import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Ledger.Devissage

/-!
# Gluing curve divisors

Compatible local coefficient functions glue to a curve divisor on a
quasi-compact integral scheme. A finite subcover bounds the support of the
glued coefficients by a finite union of the local divisor supports.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u v

open TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CurveDivisor

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [CompactSpace X]

/-- Divisors whose coefficients agree on overlaps of an open cover glue to a
global divisor. Quasi-compactness supplies the finite support of the result. -/
theorem exists_eq_on_openCover
    {ι : Type v} (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (D : ι → X.CurveDivisor)
    (hcompat : ∀ (i j : ι) (x : X) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X),
      x ∈ U i → x ∈ U j → coeffAt hx (D i) = coeffAt hx (D j)) :
    ∃ E : X.CurveDivisor, ∀ (i : ι) (x : X) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X),
      x ∈ U i → coeffAt hx E = coeffAt hx (D i) := by
  classical
  choose i hi using hcover
  let a : {x : X // x ≠ genericPoint X} → ℤ :=
    fun x => coeffAt x.2 (D (i x.1))
  have ha (x : {x : X // x ≠ genericPoint X}) (j : ι) (hx : x.1 ∈ U j) :
      a x = coeffAt x.2 (D j) :=
    hcompat (i x.1) j x.1 x.2 (hi x.1) hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover
    (fun j => (U j : Set X)) (fun j => (U j).isOpen)
    (show (Set.univ : Set X) ⊆ ⋃ j, (U j : Set X) from
      fun x _ => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i x, hi x⟩)
  have hsupport : (Function.support a).Finite := by
    refine (s.finite_toSet.biUnion fun j _ =>
      (toFinsupp (D j)).support.finite_toSet).subset ?_
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hxj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hs (Set.mem_univ x.1))
    refine Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨j, hj, ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finsupp.mem_support_iff]
    change coeffAt x.2 (D j) ≠ 0
    change a x ≠ 0 at hx
    intro hzero
    exact hx ((ha x j hxj).trans hzero)
  refine ⟨Finsupp.ofSupportFinite a hsupport, ?_⟩
  intro j x hx hxj
  change a ⟨x, hx⟩ = coeffAt hx (D j)
  exact ha ⟨x, hx⟩ j hxj

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CurveDivisor
